notes.title: Early Access Update 3: Quality of Life, new Artworks & Balancing
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!

We know many of you are eagerly awaiting controller support, and we promise it's still in the works! In the meantime, we're thrilled to bring you a huge Quality of Life update filled with improvements, visual upgrades, and balance changes to make your experience even smoother and more fun.
A huge thank you to everyone who sent us emails, comments, bug reports, and messages on Discord – your feedback truly helps us shape the game! 

[b]New[/b]
Added new artwork for the Steam library
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/6c21bf377bff0f1ea59a5f3e1c18a895027a61b0.png"][/img] Added a preview button for event options – hovering over it shows a preview of the outcome
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/09a7f9b8ce8bc3f5c042c277db4ac50efe660efc.png"][/img] Added a switch button on the character info panel and ability upgrade panel for characters with alternate forms (e.g. Hansel & Gretel)
 Added new visuals to the dice selection screen in battle to show team members and their required dice
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/d965b5c1c71668d098f3ebb0d5ecdadc4315db5a.png"][/img]Added a new button for accessing handcard inventory
 Added a dice count display on the map and in the shop
 Added new character visuals for Sophia’s Maid and Sophia’s Minion
 Added new perma card visuals for Sophia’s Maid and Sophia’s Minion
 [spoiler] Added new character visuals for Smej’s three heads, Helpless Queen, and Real Bad Wolf (Phases 2 and 3)[/spoiler]
 Added unique avatar artwork for every character
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/5e6d6b11a1e4bcf369e479126ab3cd02e54831e0.png"][/img]Added a “don’t show again” option to the Early Access popup in the main menu
 Added hover details for character cards and dice in the shop
 Added a new button image to close the book
 Added new images for the Misery Cards
 Added new target icon on targetable enemies when selecting an ability
 Added a text pop up when handcard limit is reached  
 The evil Hunter now spawns hunter dummies when taking damage 
 If you need a certain character for an event choice, their avatar is now shown [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/157d877831c02bed399b4a9a6d9b7d2fe04b918b.png"][/img]
[b]Changes[/b]   
Completely reworked the loose random handcard event outcome from 1 random selected to choosing 1 of 3 randomly selected handcards from deck 
Completely reworked the character scroll in the map screen 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/ee60ec7e723e352e7fb51584fe052bee8badb60d.png"][/img]Redesigned the Game Over screen with new artwork 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/fa10a483454398b24ed9481155a9b19393d6f2b5.png"][/img]Removed italic font styles to improve text readability  
Updated the game credits  Handcards in the shop are now selected from all possible character reward cards, so you won’t receive cards from characters not in your team  
Being Rooted no longer reduces Immunity  
A crown icon now appears on upgraded character cards as a visual indicator 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/40f8b0887cda2d24fe728c9d68663ac1e7592b3d.png"][/img]Updated the battle background image for the castle map 

[b]Bug fixes[/b]   
Fixed some localization issues  
Fixed handcard shop prices sometimes showing up wrong  
Fixed missing hover details for Jack in Jeff's shop  
Fixed an issue with Jack’s third ability not triggering correctly when using the fire variant  
Fixed receiving a status not triggering when it counters another status  
Fixed a bug where the passive ability requirement wasn't shown in the character info panel when it's an ability use requirement 

[b]Balancing[/b] 
Numerous balance changes have been made

notes.title: Early Access Update 2: Achievements 🏆
notes.content:
This update for Once Upon a Rogue's Tale introduces Steam Achievements to make your adventures even more thrilling! 

A special thank you goes out to our amazing Discord community for their fantastic ideas and suggestions for achievements. Your input has helped shape this update, and we appreciate your creativity and support.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/mMcyPme3Ck]Join our discord now![/url]

[list]
[*] Added 50 Steam Achievements (includes 7 hidden achievements)
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The dice selection button now has three phases:
Select Unused -> Select All -> Select None
[*] Exchanged some text with icons (Confirm, Return, Skip etc.)
[*] Changed Map icons for Red Riding Hood Boss 1 and 3
[*] Updated legend images of bosses to be better readable
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[*] Fixed camera shake not working anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch 03: Once Upon a Rogue’s Tale – Early Access
notes.content:
[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a visual effect when an ability is changed
[*] Added missing visuals to Queen’s Minion
[*] Added a total card count to inventory
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] All different passive upgrade descriptions now also show what the upgraded passive will be
[*] Removed cards from trade-event that need a specific character to be useful 
[*] Removed cards from shops that need a specific character to be useful
[*] When receiving a new character through an event you will now also be able to choose a new handcard for them
[*] Changed outcomes of character events to be balanced now that some options give additional cards
[*] Adjusted Spirit in Glass event outcomes 
[*] [spoiler]Permanent card Cloud Giant's Wife now gives random enemy rattled (as intended)[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]When Smej changes to its different heads, they are now stunned for their first turn[/spoiler]
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a major bug where received status effects from events where permanent -> they now only trigger once in the next fight as intended
[*] Fixed description boxes sometimes overlapping each other in the character info panel
[*] Fixed drawing lots of cards in one turn leading to unplayable cards
[*] Fixed card reward button disappearing after skipping the reward
[*] Fixed wrong outcomes of the Jellyfish event
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes status descriptions were a bit rotated

[*] The effect Rule Breaker is now reduced by 1 after being used instead of at end of turn

[*] Increased the size of status effect numbers
[*] Changed old font in scroll
[*] Ability details of Magical Prison are now hidden
[*] Info texts for Rübezahl-Bear and Enchanter are rewritten to fit better
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a major bug where strange things would happen if you lost a boss fight
[*] Many localization and text fixes
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the character reserve box of the character selection panel
[*] Fixed a bug happening when having Fire Tendrils together with Swing 
[*] Removed the possibility to click multiple times on popup buttons resulting in getting negative wishes
[*][spoiler]Fixed a visual bug when using the “Adventures of the Little Tailor” difficulty setting and receiving two card rewards[/spoiler]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]

We're still working on some other bugs and quality-of-life stuff, but we wanted to do a quick update because of the major boss bug. We're a small team and we're doing our best to make this game enjoyable, but please have a little patience with us! Thank you so much!

Dear Fairytale fans, a big demo update is waiting for you!
The Replayability Update is now live and, as the name suggests, comes with many new features and upgrades that will make your runs even more individual and offer new unlockable content.

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] A brand new shop in between runs
[/list][i]Our goat Jeff found life as a simple goat that only eats cards too boring and decided to open his own store! This store features new unlockable passive abilities for your main character, new unlockable events and special one-time run upgrades for your next run. Later this will be the place where you also unlock new main characters and their adventures.[/i]
[b]Notice:[/b] The shop will appear for the first time after your first run.
[list]
[*] A new resource: Wishes
[/list][i]After each battle, in addition to the typical battle rewards, a new bar will be filled up. When it is full, you will receive a wish that you can exchange in Jeff's new Wish Shop![/i]
[list]
[*] New enemies: Little Witch and Little High-born Sir[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/b661d590989cbde49f1988de3a7b351d3797b973.png[/img]
(Little Witch will also be available as a buyable companion in the chapter 2 shop)
[list]
[*] New event requirements
[/list][i]You will now come across events where certain selection options are linked to requirements. These can be: Coins, health, team size, specific hand cards, specific characters in the team or previous events.[/i]
[list]
[*] New event punishments

notes.title: Demo release! + Regular update: saving, balancing, new visuals and more
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

it's finally here. The official demo of Once Upon a Rogue's Tale is now available to play!
We hope that you will enjoy the game as much as we do. We will continue working on the demo while its online to get you new content and fix those nasty bugs you might encounter.

Have fun!

[b]New[/b]

[list]

Once Upon a Rogue’s Tale Patch Notes – V 0.1.9 (27.02.2024)

[b]New[/b]

[list]
[*] Chapter 2 of Red Riding Hood

[*] New Language: German
[*] German voice lines for intro and outro texts

[*] Fixed all bugs related to character swapping
[*] Fixed wrong button highlights in events
[*] Fixed perma cards not banishing themselves
[*] Fixed lots of overlapping or wrong text
[*] Fixed dice scene not freezing when no dice available
[*] Fixed characters sometimes turning into other character at end of battle
[*] Fixed Quit Game button not working
[*] Fixed ending screen not showing when dying in boss- or event battle
[/list]
